title: X bearer token in an Authorization header
summary: A synthetic token after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of an X API request, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map. The values contain only letters, digits and hyphens.
rationale: X documents a Bearer header for both an OAuth 2.0 user access token, which replaces the app-only Bearer Token, and the app-only Bearer Token itself. The header cannot tell the two apart, so the case is shared and the attribution stays generic. X states the Bearer Token is a byte array of unspecified format, so no prefix, alphabet or width is claimed and the scheme is the only identifying context. Percent-containing shapes appear only as tool-corroborated leads in the contract and are not a provider statement; whether a raw token may contain a percent character or only a serialised form does, is unresolved, and no fixture contains a percent character in the value. The extent is the value after the scheme and excludes the closing quote.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value after an explicit Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of an X API request is treated as a credential and covered whole. X documents the Bearer carrier of the user access token and of the app-only token and states that the byte format is unspecified (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic authorization attribution are the project's decisions. Percent-containing shapes are not asserted either way.
